title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
author: John Boyne
summary: Bruno, the nine-year-old son of a Nazi commandant, is moved to a bleak house in the countryside and befriends a boy who lives behind the wire fence in what Bruno takes to be a strange farm.
readIf: you want a very short, simply told fable about childhood innocence set during the Holocaust.
skipIf: you want historical accuracy; many readers and historians criticise its plausibility.

pairings.reason: A fuller and more textured novel about a child's life in Nazi Germany.
Another novel where a child's experience of the Holocaust is uncovered by someone in the present.
A story set inside a camp, aimed at adults, also with a simple style.
